description: Wonewoc, WI – Rep. Ed Brooks will be giving his time as well as his endorsement to Tony Kurtz’s campaign for the State Assembly this year. The outgoing representative announced this week that he will be serving as the campaign’s treasurer.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Kurtz For Assembly
title: Rep. Ed Brooks to Serve as Tony Kurtz’s Campaign Treasurer - Kurtz For Assembly
